config.background_crossfade: complementary linear weights; same three-second parent repeated; no normalization
config.independence: group all derived scenes by original UTC collection day; repeated SNR/seeds and vessels are dependent; five days form one connected day-vessel component; no independent-component confidence interval
config.model_training: fully synthetic temporal CNN; no semi-synthetic fitting, threshold selection or test-driven modification
config.parent_selection: hash-sorted metadata; unique background and source windows within day/base-scene set; two-source scenes use distinct vessel identities
config.prediction_decoding: exactly frozen synthetic_temporal.json proposal thresholds, NMS and approximate 128ms grid
config.scene_pairing: same parents, offsets and taper across component-SNR conditions and detector seeds; zero-insertion controls repeat unchanged across SNR
config.source_snr_definition: whole noisy tapered excerpt RMS divided by constructed-background RMS over its insertion support; overlapping components each scaled separately
config.source_taper: sin-squared, half-sample-centered edges; positive over all inserted samples
config.truth_definition: union of insertion supports; not natural event truth or isolated vessel audibility

limitations: Insertion labels are known by construction; no natural real event timing or clean-source truth exists.
AIS-positive source excerpts contain ambient noise and may not contain an audible target; component SNR is not clean vessel SNR.
AIS-negative backgrounds may contain untracked or distant sources; zero inserted excerpts does not imply acoustic silence.
Looped three-second backgrounds are artificial and contain deterministic crossfade structure.
All conditions reuse 330 base scenes and five collection days; 990 condition-scenes are not independent encounters.
Shared vessel identities connect the five test days; no independent-component confidence interval is estimable.
Two-source insertion supports are unioned; overlapping physical sources are not separated.
Transferred synthetic detector is evaluated without adaptation; this does not establish improvement on natural recordings.
